13830.title: Ethics of Communication on Social Media from the Perspective of Muhammad Hasbi Ash-Shiddieqy’s Exegesis: An Analysis of the Concept of Hate Speech in the Qur’an
13830.authors: Muhammad Almi, Muhammad Yasir, Zailani Zailani, Masyhuri Putra, Nasrul Fatah
13830.journal: Al Muhafidz: Jurnal Ilmu Al-Qur'an dan Tafsir
13830.abstract: Technological developments have changed communication patterns, with digital platforms often triggering hate speech and social conflict. The Qur'an provides ethical speech guidelines emphasizing honesty, prohibiting slander, and promoting caution in conveying information. This study examines Muhammad Hasbi Ash-Shiddieqy's exegesis of Qur'anic verses related to hate speech and formulates ethical speech principles for social media from his perspective. Using qualitative library research with thematic exegesis (tafsir mawḍū'ī) and descriptive-analytical methods, this study reconstructs Hasbi's ethical framework. The findings reveal six principles of Qur'anic communication ethics relevant to dig…

14009.title: Internalisasi Nilai Tawadhu dalam Menghadapi Krisis Budaya Hedonisme Kontemporer: Kajian Tafsir Maudhu’i dalam Tafsir Kementerian Agama RI
14009.authors: M Farhan Pamungkas, Abdul Malik Ghozali, Kiki Muhamad Hakiki
14009.abstract: As the primary foundation of Islamic teachings, the concept of tawadhu' (humility) plays a significant role in shaping social ethics and human character. In the modern era, characterized by the growing influence of hedonistic culture a lifestyle oriented toward material pleasure, luxury, and self-image the value of tawadhu' has become increasingly essential as a moral and spiritual counterbalance. 25887.title: RÛH IN THE QUR'AN: AN ANALYSIS OF AL-NAISÂBÛRÎ'S EXEGESIS
25887.authors: Siti Salbiyah, Wardani Wardani, Hanafi Hanafi
25887.abstract: The concept of rûh has long been a subject of profound intellectual inquiry within Islamic thought, particularly in the field of Qur'anic exegesis. Although the Qur'an acknowledges the limited knowledge granted to humankind concerning the rûh (Q.S. al-Isrâ'/17:85), various interpretations have emerged to explore its possible meanings. This study examines the concept of rûh through the interpretation of al-Naisâbûrî in his Tafsîr Gharâ'ib al-Qur'ân wa Raghâ'ib al-Furqân. Employing a qualitative descriptive-analytical approach based on library research, this study finds that al-Naisâbûrî provides a multidimensional interpretation of rûh, encompassing meanings such as the soul, divine revelatio…

20976.title: To dispel the suspicion of injustice concerning God Almighty's statement: "When We decide to destroy a population, We (first) send a definite order to those among them who are given the good things of this life and yet transgress; so that the word is proved true against them: then (it is) We destroy them utterly" [Al-Israa, Ayat 16 (17: 16 Quran)
20976.abstract: The research examines the doubt related to the justice of Allah, as mentioned in His statement, "When We decide to destroy a population, We (first) send a definite order to those among them who are given the good things of this life and yet transgress; so that the word is proved true against them: then (it is) We destroy them utterly." [Quran, Surah Al-Isra, 17: 16], and what might lead to the perception of a contradiction with His saying, "And no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another." [Quran, Surah Al-Isra, 17: 15]. 27248.abstract: Bu makale İsrâ Sûresi 85. âyetteki “ruh” kavramını, tarihî süreçteki yorumlar ışığında analiz etmeyi amaçlamaktadır. 25968.title: Birlikte Yaşama Kültürünün Kur’ânî Temelleri (İsra Suresi 23-29 Ayetleri Özelinde)
25968.abstract: İnsan tek başına yaşayabilme kabiliyetine sahip olmayan, başka insanların varlığına ihtiyaç duyan toplumsal bir varlıktır. İnsanlık, yaratılış maksadının gerçekleşmesi için tarih boyunca hep başka insanlarla birlikte yaşamıştır. Bu nedenle Kur’ân insanlara, “Ey İnsanlar” şeklinde hitap etmiş, hayatı ve yaşamı toplumsal birlikteliği sağlayacak şekilde düzenlemiştir. 27251.title: KUR’AN HİTABINDA AİLEVÎ DAVRANIŞLARIN YÖNLENDİRİLMESİ: DİNÎ İNANÇ IŞIĞINDA İSRÂ SÛRESİ 23-24. ÂYETLERİNİN SEMANTİK İNCELENMESİ
27251.abstract: Dinî inanç gerek insanın kişiliğinin inşasında gerekse bireysel ve toplumsal davranışlarının yönlendirilmesinde belirleyici bir role sahiptir. İslam düşüncesinde aile, inancın ahlakî davranışa dönüştüğü temel bir kurum olarak öne çıkar. Kur’ân-ı Kerîm, iman ile ahlakî sorumluluk arasındaki bağı özellikle ebeveyn-evlat ilişkisi üzerinden temellendirir. 441.title: Bir Retorik Olarak İnsanın “Eşref-i Mahlukat” İddiası (İsrâ Sûresi 70. Âyet bağlamında) / As a Rhetoric, Man's Claim of "Eşref-i Mahlukat" (In the context of the 70th verse of the Isra Surah)
441.abstract: Kur’ân-ı Kerîm’de insanın değerine olumlu manada işaret eden birçok âyet olduğu gibi onun hata, günah ve kusurlarına da temas eden âyetler vardır.
